mapper.select: select count(distinct t.system_code) as system_count, count(1) as task_count, sum(case when x.status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count, sum(case when x.status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end) as running_count, sum(case when x.status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end) as success_count, sum(case when x.status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failed_count, sum(case when x.status = 'DELAYED' then 1 else 0 end) as delayed_count, sum(case when x.status = 'TIMEOUT' then 1 else 0 end) as timeout_count from ( select i.task_code, case when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'SUCCESS' then 'SUCCESS' when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'FAILED' then 'FAILED' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null and now() > i.predict_end_time then 'TIMEOUT' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null then 'RUNNING' when i.actual_start_time is null and now() > i.plan_start_time then 'DELAYED' else 'PENDING' end as status from monitor_task_instance i where i.biz_date = #{bizDate} ) x left join monitor_task t on x.task_code = t.task_code

select i.task_code, t.task_name, i.system_code, s.system_name, t.owner_name, t.supervisor_name, case when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'SUCCESS' then 'SUCCESS' when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'FAILED' then 'FAILED' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null and now() > i.predict_end_time then 'TIMEOUT' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null then 'RUNNING' when i.actual_start_time is null and now() > i.plan_start_time then 'DELAYED' else 'PENDING' end as status, i.plan_start_time, i.latest_start_time, i.plan_end_time, i.actual_start_time, i.actual_end_time, i.current_cost_minutes as current_cost_seconds, t.avg_cost_minutes as avg_cost_seconds, i.predict_end_time from monitor_task_instance i left join monitor_system s on i.system_code = s.system_code left join monitor_task t on i.task_code = t.task_code where i.biz_date = #{bizDate} and (#{pageCode} is null or t.display_flag = '1') order by i.plan_start_time asc, i.task_code asc

select i.task_code, t.task_name, i.system_code, s.system_name, t.owner_name, t.supervisor_name, case when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'SUCCESS' then 'SUCCESS' when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'FAILED' then 'FAILED' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null and now() > i.predict_end_time then 'TIMEOUT' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null then 'RUNNING' when i.actual_start_time is null and now() > i.plan_start_time then 'DELAYED' else 'PENDING' end as status, i.plan_start_time, i.latest_start_time, i.plan_end_time, i.actual_start_time, i.actual_end_time, i.current_cost_minutes as current_cost_seconds, t.avg_cost_minutes as avg_cost_seconds, i.predict_end_time from monitor_task_instance i left join monitor_system s on i.system_code = s.system_code left join monitor_task t on i.task_code = t.task_code where i.biz_date = #{bizDate} and i.task_code = #{taskCode} limit 1

select pre_task_code as from_task_code, task_code as to_task_code, direction as dependency_type, '1' as strong_dependency_flag, '' as output_desc from monitor_task_dependency d order by pre_task_code asc, task_code asc
